image_audit.excluded: Source identifiers, later reference surfaces, reference EF, hidden patient and author code are absent. Full cropped image volume and the initial reference surface are intentionally supplied, along with the old case solver.

author_review.task_validity: Selected reference-backed initialized reconstruction pilot, with clinical-annotation uncertainty; not a confirmed etiologic-diagnosis dataset
author_review.model_execution: Normal completion, not timeout or infrastructure failure
author_review.model_artifact: Valid closed dynamic cavity surface; independent numeric regrading matches all metrics
author_review.adaptation: Executable uses actual B-mode volumes through sequential 3D TV-L1, not per-frame fixed tables. It runs on both hidden patients and passes still/phase-shift controls.
author_review.diagnostic_result: All three functional severity labels disagree with their clinical surface-derived references. Geometry undercontraction overestimates ESV and underestimates EF; calibration gates fail.
author_review.uncertainty: Heuristic residual/closure sensitivity ranges, explicitly not clinical confidence intervals; all three miss the corresponding reference.
author_review.etiologic_restraint: The submission appropriately declines infarction, ischemic cause, valve severity, hemodynamics and myocardial material-strain claims.

pre_model_assessment.functional_impression: Visually reduced LV systolic function, provisionally in the mild-to-moderate reduction range; preserved function appears less likely, but the broad class is uncertain before 3D fitting.

reasons: The orthogonal images are unannotated center-plane views of a 3D acquisition and may be foreshortened or miss maximal boundaries.
Basal valve-plane motion and the true blood-pool boundary are difficult to judge from B-mode intensity alone.
No quantitative contour propagation, closed-surface volume, Doppler, or clinical context has yet been used.

supporting_frame_references.observation: The LV cavity appears near its largest extent in both long-axis previews, consistent with end-diastolic phases at the ends of the acquired beat.
The cavity appears narrowest in the long-axis previews, but the visible inward excursion is modest and substantial residual cavity remains.
Intermediate cavity sizes on contraction and relaxation support a coherent beat rather than isolated frame noise.

pre_model_assessment.initial_limits: This visual assessment concerns cavity systolic function only. These B-mode images do not establish etiology, infarction, ischemia, valve severity, hemodynamics, or myocardial material strain.
pre_model_assessment.source: Direct inspection of supplied volumes.npy via the corresponding orthogonal frame views; no fitted dynamic geometry or prior-case measurements used.

author_review.pre_to_post: Initial mild-to-moderate visual impression contains the mild reference category. Deferring to the fitted model moved the primary assessment to severe. Descriptive within-session observation, not causal benefit measurement.
author_review.reviewer: Author code, numerical replay and visual overlay review; no independent cardiologist adjudication
author_review.visual_review: At reference systole, predicted contours lie outside the reference especially across the mid-cavity, leaving too large a cavity. All compared views are inside the input volume, not unseen-plane generalization.
author_review.acceptance: Separate artifact validity, input-response adaptation, geometric accuracy, EF/ESV, functional severity and unsupported claims; retain frozen gates without post-result adjustment.
author_review.normal_control_provenance: Supplementary control added after dispatch; first candidate rejected for sector truncation, replaced before model completion using input quality only.

posthoc_geometry_diagnostic.scope: Posthoc descriptive geometry, initial local-axis thirds; neither AHA segments nor myocardial strain

limitations: One selected development patient and one model attempt do not establish a capability ceiling or clinical accuracy.
All scans are public and pretraining exposure is unknown.
Native archive bytes match publisher LFS hashes; publisher array-hash serialization was not reproduced by raw C-order hashing.
Reference surfaces are operator/software-derived and may contain errors; there is no independent cardiologist adjudication.
Initial reference surfaces are supplied; this is not raw segmentation from scratch.
LV endocardial surface indices do not establish myocardial material tracking or strain.
Functional-reference labels do not establish heart-failure syndrome, valve disease or disease etiology.
Image-only and post-model impressions from one session are descriptive, not a controlled diagnostic-benefit comparison.
The preserved-function control was added after dispatch and replaced on input-quality grounds before model completion.
